audit.why: HARD / 8/10 fits 41.21% over 313 games with Tryndamere owning every row through first item.
audit.corrected: Left at HARD, 8/10; report[14].t's 41.1% is within rounding of the packet's 41.21%.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[2].text and late attribute his first-item snowball to 'his E reset on kill/assist'.
audit.why: Riot's text for Spinning Slash says only that he slices toward a target unit, dealing damage in his path. There is no kill/assist reset in it. What actually changes at first item is the rank-up: 12s at rank 1 down to 8s at rank 5, which is why he can close and leave at will.
audit.corrected: The reset claim removed and replaced with the real 8-12s cooldown; Undying Rage's 80-120s named as the timer you play around.

audit.whatIsWrong: Mocking Shout is described as a flat slow that stops you kiting or fleeing, in four places. Grievous Wounds is never mentioned.
audit.why: Mocking Shout reduces surrounding champions' attack damage, but it slows ONLY enemies with their backs turned to him. That inverts the advice: walking away is what gets you slowed, and Highlander's slow immunity blanks it outright. Bloodlust converts his Fury into a heal on a flat 12s, which is what makes Grievous Wounds decisive (missingInteractions).
audit.corrected: W written with the back-turned condition and its flat 14s/850 range; anti-heal stated for Bloodlust.

edits.before: At 2 his W slow and AD-cut stop you kiting while Bloodlust out-sustains Meditate.
edits.after: At 2 Mocking Shout (W) cuts your AD and slows you the second you turn away.

edits.before: Tryndamere out-spins you: his Spinning Slash (E) gap-closes and crits stack Fury faster than your Alpha Strike (Q) trade, and Mocking Shout (W) slows you and cuts your AD so you can't kite or run. Every extended trade fills his Fury bar, which heals him with Bloodlust (Q) — you cannot out-sustain that with Meditate.
edits.after: Tryndamere out-spins you: Spinning Slash (E) gap-closes on 12s and his Fury crits stack faster than your Alpha Strike trade. Mocking Shout (W) cuts your AD at 850 range and only slows you when your back is TURNED, so never walk away from him. Bloodlust (Q) spends that Fury as a heal, and Grievous Wounds is the answer to it.

edits.before: He crits harder than you do off a first item, and his E reset on kill/assist means he snowballs faster in skirmishes. Your Wuju true damage helps in a straight fight, but his slow (W) and Undying Rage still let him win the duel outright.
edits.after: He crits harder than you do off a first item, and Spinning Slash (E) ranks down to 8s so he closes and leaves at will. Your Wuju true damage helps in a straight fight, but Bloodlust's heal and Undying Rage still let him win the duel outright.

edits.before: This is one of your worst lanes: Tryndamere out-trades you at every level 1-5. His Spinning Slash (E) closes gaps and crits build Fury, Mocking Shout (W) slows you and slices your AD so you can neither trade nor flee, and Bloodlust (Q) heals him past your Meditate. Farm from max range, take safe CS, and expect to give up plates rather than fight.

Spinning Slash (E) closes gaps on 12s, Mocking Shout (W) slices your AD and slows you only once your back is turned, and Bloodlust (Q) turns his Fury into a heal past your Meditate. edits.before: Even at first item he crits harder and his E resets snowball him in skirmishes; the lane only levels out once you're deep into two-plus items and your true-damage on-hits plus Highlander attack speed finally match his crit output. Realistically, out-farm him, group with your team, and split or burst him only when his Undying Rage is on cooldown.
edits.after: Even at first item he crits harder and Spinning Slash keeps him mobile in skirmishes; the lane only levels once you are deep into two-plus items and your true-damage on-hits plus Highlander attack speed match his crit output. edits.after: Alpha Strike's untargetability dodges his spin damage briefly but not a follow-up E, and Highlander's slow-immunity ignores Mocking Shout outright — but neither answers Undying Rage, which voids your reset-on-kill loop for five seconds; Bloodlust heals off his Fury, so Grievous Wounds is what makes an extended trade winnable at all.

notes: Two real corrections. Mocking Shout only slows enemies whose backs are TURNED to Tryndamere — the page treated it as an unconditional slow that stops you kiting, which reverses the actual advice (walking away is what triggers it, and Highlander blanks it entirely). And Spinning Slash has no kill/assist reset in Riot's text; the page claimed one twice, so I replaced it with the real 12s-to-8s rank scaling. The packet suspectName on 'His Spinning Slash' is a false positive. Level chart matches the packet, no chart edits.
